'''Dream Bough''' {{co|50|11|Feralas}} is an area in the northwestern part of [[Feralas]] which has one of the four known entrances to the [[Emerald Dream]].  The area is guarded by Elite Green [[Dragonspawn]] and the [[drake]]s [[Lethlas]] and [[Dreamroarer]].

One of the four [[Dragons of Nightmare]] bosses randomly spawns here.
